parameters.query:
INSERT INTO rejected_sessions (session_id, title, meeting_type, confidence_score, summary, reject_reason, session_date, participants)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::numeric, $5, $6, $7::timestamptz, $8::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE SET
  title = EXCLUDED.title, meeting_type = EXCLUDED.meeting_type, confidence_score = EXCLUDED.confidence_score,
  summary = EXCLUDED.summary, reject_reason = EXCLUDED.reject_reason, session_date = EXCLUDED.session_date,
  participants = EXCLUDED.participants, archived_at = now()
RETURNING session_id, meeting_type, confidence_score, reject_reason, 'archived - no embeddings generated' AS status;

WITH purged AS (DELETE FROM knowledge_vault WHERE session_id = $1 RETURNING 1)
SELECT $1::text AS session_id, count(*)::int AS purged_chunks FROM purged;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO knowledge_vault (session_id, stream_type, content, metadata, embedding)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb, $5::vector)
ON CONFLICT (session_id, stream_type, md5(content)) DO UPDATE SET
  metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata, embedding = EXCLUDED.embedding
RETURNING id, session_id, stream_type, length(content) AS chars;

parameters.content:
## Workflow A: Ingestion & Semantic Firewall
Run with **Execute workflow**. Reads /data/mock_transcripts.json -> bounded sample (first 40 + last 20 turns) -> LLM classifier -> **Ingestion Gate**.
- Approved (Client Coaching, confidence >= 0.80): dual-stream parse -> embed -> upsert into knowledge_vault
- Rejected: flat row in rejected_sessions, **no embedding is ever generated**
